acceptanceCriteria: A CI log shows the binding test running (migrated count printed) or the test fails instead of skipping when CI=true; the spec row's native-map count matches the corpus.
body:
Panel finding (test-conformance), SUSPECTED by code reading, not seen in a CI log. internal/cem/wire/corpus_test.go:79 TestCEMV1201CommittedCorpusBinding skips at :85/:127/:141 when Git is unavailable; the package reports ok. CI runs internal/cem/wire under Landlock confinement with no .git read (.corvint/test-read-scopes.json:200-210, .github/testconfine/scopes.go:76,:183). With GIT_DIR=/nonexistent locally the test reports SKIP and the package passes. The traceability row at docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md:839 cites it as evidence and counts 6 native maps where a local run finds 15. The parity tool that produced the migration numbers (tools/cem-convert-parity) was deleted in 1e3930290, so the 613-identical result cannot be rerun from main.

Version: origin/main f8ea0758ee1b77bb45931818e47ae1a9a95d1d59 (2026-10-13). Panel evidence (scratch, not retained in-tree): /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-russelllewis-projects-corvint/b89960c8-2163-4353-8ea9-7b6117332c1b/scratchpad/panel/<lens>/.
title: Suspected: CEM-V1-201 corpus binding test NOT_RUN-skips under CI confinement and is counted as evidence
